capabilities.COUNTY_IDENTITY: Canonical FIPS/name/countyId identity exists in the 254-county runtime registry.
capabilities.COUNTY_BOUNDARY_GEOMETRY: Authoritative polygon or multipolygon exists in the governed statewide package.
capabilities.COUNTY_BOUNDS_AVAILABLE_TO_RUNTIME: A bounding box is present in GRIDLY_COUNTY_AWARENESS_BOUNDS_BY_ID and can seed fitBounds/candidate selection.
capabilities.PLACE_COUNTY_MEMBERSHIPS: All governed county memberships; no invented primary county.
capabilities.PLACE_PRESENTATION_CAMERA: Governed presentation coordinate and existing zoom behavior.
capabilities.PLACE_SEARCH: Canonical PLACE is included in runtime awareness-area search.
capabilities.ZIP_TO_PLACE_RESOLUTION: A governed ZIP record resolves automatically to an awareness community; partial ZIP evidence is not equivalent to statewide PLACE coverage.
capabilities.ROAD_GEOMETRY_ROAD_DATA: Locally governed or explicitly external Gridly roadway geometry; basemap tiles excluded.
capabilities.ROAD_RUNTIME_AVAILABILITY: Road manifest exposes a loadable local/external/partition runtime.
capabilities.RAIL_CROSSING_SOURCE: Governed statewide FRA source contains county records, or zero records is authoritatively observed.
capabilities.RAIL_CROSSING_RUNTIME: County runtime source is configured available.
capabilities.CONSUMER_VISIBLE_CROSSINGS: Certified public-roadway records can reach consumer rendering.
capabilities.HAZARD_REPORT_PLACEMENT: Tap/GPS coordinate can resolve to a supported county and pass pre-insert coverage validation.
capabilities.HAZARD_REPORT_PERSISTENCE: Client can insert and retrieve report rows; remote schema/RLS requires live verification.
capabilities.HAZARD_RUNTIME_VISIBILITY: Accepted local hazard and remote refresh enter awareness rendering.
capabilities.COMMUNITY_REPORT_PERSISTENCE: Supabase insert/retrieval path, subject to remote verification.
capabilities.AWARENESS_FILTERS: Selected county/community filtering works; crossing filters additionally require inventory.
capabilities.COUNTY_CONTAINMENT: Coordinate candidate bounds plus authoritative polygon resolve exactly one operational county.
capabilities.ROUTE_WATCH_SUPPORT: Route context can consume roads/hazards; governed road runtime determines local completeness.
capabilities.REGION_METRO_SPECIAL_GOVERNANCE: Separate governed child-region overlays where defined; otherwise not applicable.
capabilities.REMOTE_SUPABASE_DEPENDENCY: Report persistence and cross-device retrieval depend on remote Supabase.
capabilities.MAP_PRESENTATION: County/PLACE camera can frame map; county framing requires runtime bounds.

source.geometryPreservation: source geometry copied without simplification or regeneration

hazards.firstRootCause: 226 counties absent from GRIDLY_COUNTY_AWARENESS_BOUNDS_BY_ID, so gridlyResolveCountyIdForCoordinate produces countyId null and createSharedHazardReport returns coverage_invalid before Supabase insert.

fullSupport.reasonNoFullSupport: No county has repository evidence that certifies current remote Supabase schema/RLS/cross-device persistence plus exhaustive ZIP applicability; 28 have the strongest local runtime cohort.
